P5 B3R 200-question DEV set-aware minus random FS@2 is −0.025 [−0.058,+0.010] at two pairs and −0.027 [−0.057,−0.000] at five pairs, after averaging three seeds. These CIs resample questions, not training seeds; multiple policy comparisons are unadjusted.

The public page is a dated and sanitized snapshot, not live Slurm telemetry. A running allocation or scoring checkpoint is not a completed scientific result.

audit.methodology: P1 C5 D3 documents effective-batch-preserving microbatch repair and no sequence-length fallback, but only one gold-only fit is completed. Paired nDCG and G5 remain unmeasured. C6 is mid-teacher-scoring, not an evaluated multi-domain comparison. P5 B3R 95% intervals bootstrap 200 DEV questions after averaging three seeds; they omit training-seed uncertainty and multiplicity, and student is a residual query adapter rather than a fully fine-tuned bi-encoder.
audit.split_integrity: P1 C5 SciFact train 505, INNER 100 exploratory, holdout 200 previously exposed in C2 and planned final-use C5; beware repeated per-fit writes and never retune on them. P1 C6 NFCorpus and FiQA official test qrels are reserved for post-training final evaluation; no official test metric verified. P5 B3R sampled 1,000 training from 6,742 and used DEV 200; 400 pilot holdout rows were not materialized, but the prior pilot already exposed that holdout.
audit.cost: P5 B3R physical union scores 9,857 endpoints, with counterfactual uncached per-arm counts. Two pairs: random 508,381 vs set-aware 508,091 input tokens; five pairs: random 971,006 vs set-aware 1,252,556 (+29%). C6 NFCorpus teacher scoring observed 64,032/100,000 target pairs; no completed end-to-end teacher-cost or GPU-hour accounting. C5 reuses pinned MedCPT teacher scores without new teacher calls.
audit.novelty: New B3R DEV comparison is negative for set-aware selection, not a new contribution. P1 teacher selection has prior art in GPL/PairDistill/PRD; P5 set utility and pairwise supervision overlap SCARLet, PRD, DISCo, SetR. Distinguish the hypothesis of boundary-aware training-time allocation from measured results.
